user_saw: With OpenShell v0.1.3, sessions using an adopted legacy OpenShell sandbox were refused with a 'recreate the sandbox' error because the sandbox list call used flags the CLI no longer accepts.
summary: Reads the legacy sandbox lifecycle phase from `openshell sandbox get --output json` instead of paging `sandbox list --limit/--offset`, and updates the E2E fixture's cleanup pagination, custom-image build and loopback gateway for the v0.1.3 CLI.
reasoning: GraphQL blame shows the removed `sandbox list --limit ... --offset ... --output json` phase lookup came from ac157b3af0cd (#115058, 2026-07-28), written against the OpenShell CLI current at the time; the fix PR states these CLI contracts were removed by OpenShell v0.1.3, an external tool change. The in-repo exposure is the dependency refresh 0320b94b6958 (#174410), which moved the CI pin from v0.1.2 to v0.1.3, so I record it as trigger rather than cause; I could not independently verify the upstream flag removal beyond the PR's baseline CI evidence.
